ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD with name and phone on the contact page
ideas.why: The contact page has a phone number and no entity markup, so this gives machines a concrete, specific identity signal.

ideas.idea: Add a table of mooring sizes and seasonal prices as real text on /moorings
ideas.why: The page description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the body gives only one figure, so adding them is accurate and helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Show the FAQ Q&A as visible text on the home page
ideas.why: The FAQ answers exist only in JSON-LD on index.astro, so visible text matches the markup and helps readers.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is accurate but conditional on knowing the dates and has little effect on a three-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with @astrojs/sitemap and set site in astro.config
ideas.why: It is accurate, but a hand-written three-URL sitemap works and the benefit is mostly maintainability.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and Open Graph tags to the head
ideas.why: The layout does lack them, but this is standard advice for any site.

ideas.idea: Wrap the slot in a <main> element
ideas.why: This is accurate but a minor, boilerplate semantic improvement with little effect.

ideas.idea: Make the home page description and spelling consistent (Harbor/Harbour, Cornwall/Falmouth) and say who the harbour office is
ideas.why: The title uses 'Harbor' and 'Cornwall' while the heading and description use 'Falmouth' and 'harbour', so the inconsistency is real and the fix helps clarity.

ideas.idea: Add inline links from the home page body to /moorings and /contact
ideas.why: The home page body has no links, but the nav already links both pages, so the effect is small.
